title: Anthropic fell ~5% in after-hours trading on its debut day, following a record $107.3B IPO (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Anthropic fell ~5% in after-hours trading on its debut day, following a record $107.3B IPO — Anthropic PBC shares fell on their second day of trading as a broad market selloff and doubts about the AI trade overshadowed the optimism that had fueled a rally on its record-setting debut.
